fusions.name: Many Small Doses
fusions.desc: Looses 4 small fangs in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each deals 3 damage, with a 35% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: The Full Measure
fusions.desc: Fires one long fang that deals 15 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Knot of Hatchlings
fusions.desc: Turns loose a swarm of hatchling vipers for 14 seconds. It bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Immunity Is a Rumour
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 10% poison resistance.
